verdicts.reason: Both separate the shoe from its circle, so the circle is an empty disc on the left and the product floats on the far right. Both also put GROVE under the headline and shrink the 'Find It Near You' CTA to a tiny pill no bigger than the badges, with the tilted FREE DELIVERY sticker shoved into the button row. A's subhead almost touches the pill row, but its pills and CTA text are a bit larger and easier to read. B's pills are smaller and the CTA text is barely legible, and the row sits jammed near the bottom edge, so A wins only by a little.
